name: Fever API
tagline: Curated experiences and local-event marketplace API for discovery, ticketing, and bookings
description: Fever (Feverup) is a marketplace for curated local experiences, activities, and events. Public developer documentation describes partner/integration access for listing inventory, discovery, and ticket-related workflows rather than a fully open self-serve public API. Confirm partner status and credentials before production use; many endpoints and commercial terms are gated.

auth.details: Partner/integration credentials; public self-serve API key signup not clearly documented. Contact Fever for access.

use_cases: search curated local experiences in a city
list available ticket options for an experience
integrate Fever inventory into a travel or city guide app
